transcript.text: Hi there! Thanks for calling. I'm here to help you get an auto insurance quote filled out today. What's your name?

Great! To get started on your quote, I'll need a couple of pieces of information from you. Can you give me your full name and your date of birth? Just the date in the format year, month, day — so like 1990-03-15, for example.
Hi there, yeah I'm looking to get a quote for auto insurance on my car - I need full coverage.
Absolutely, I can help you get that full coverage quote set up. To get started, I'll need your full name and your date of birth in that year-month-day format — so something like 1990-03-15.
Oh right, sorry - my name is Sarah Mitchell, and my birthday is 1989-04-12.
Perfect, thank you Sarah! I'm getting that information filled in for you now.
So what else do you need from me to get this quote going?

Great question! I'm getting your information entered into the system right now, and once that's done we'll move on to details about your car and coverage preferences. Let me get this submitted and then I'll let you know what comes next.
Perfect! Now I just need your email address and phone number so we can finalize your quote.
Sure, my email is sarah.mitchell89@gmail.com and my phone number is 415-555-0173.
Perfect, I've got that down. Let me get your email and phone number entered into the system right now.
Okay sounds good. So after this, what other information will you still need from me?

Great question! Once I get your email and phone number submitted, I'll need some details about your car — things like the make, model, year, and current mileage — and then we can talk through your coverage preferences to make sure we get you that full coverage quote you're looking for.
Perfect! So I just need your street address, city, and ZIP code to keep moving forward with your quote.
My address is 2847 Fillmore Street, San Francisco, 94123.

Wonderful, thank you! I'm getting that address filled in now — 2847 Fillmore Street, San Francisco, 94123. Once I have that submitted, I'll need a few details about your car to move forward with the quote.
Great, thanks. So for my car, it's a 2021 Toyota RAV4. What else do you need to know about it?
Perfect! A 2021 Toyota RAV4 — I'm getting that information entered in now. Just to confirm, that's Toyota for the make, RAV4 for the model, and 2021 for the year, correct?
Great, so I've got your address all filled in. Now I need a few more details about your vehicle to complete the quote. Can you tell me the make, model, and year of your car?

Perfect! So we're almost done here. You mentioned you wanted full coverage — just to confirm, that's one of our options along with Liability only and Standard. And one last thing I need to ask: have you had any prior insurance claims in the last five years?
No, I haven't had any claims in the last five years. And yeah, full coverage is what I want.
Perfect! That's great to hear. I'm getting all of that information submitted for you right now — full coverage and no prior claims in the last five years. One moment while we finalize your quote.
Sounds good. So once this goes through, will I get the quote right away or how does that work?
Your quote request is being submitted right now, and once it goes through you should receive it via email at sarah.mitchell89@gmail.com within just a few moments.

Alright Sarah, I've got everything filled in for you — your name, date of birth, email, phone number, your address on Fillmore Street in San Francisco, and all the details about your 2021 Toyota RAV4 with full coverage and no prior claims. Let me submit this quote request for you right now.
Excellent news! Your quote request has been submitted successfully. Your reference number is Q-1, and you should receive your quote via email shortly at sarah.mitchell89@gmail.com. You're all set!
